content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link as underdetermined by whether the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows leave the verse's sense open, rather than weighing the pressed chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse': reading one, the judge may leave the link underdetermined because the verse's own sense remains open; reading two, the judge must weigh the pressed chains by footing and not rely on that open verse sense.","why":"The judge resolves the collision by the verse's open sense after row-level lexical/fulfillment arguments, which is the verse-by-verse and stating-verse approach K-C retires."}
